Q1.known_answer: No. E-17 is listed as Excluded? = No. Water damage from a sudden and accidental rupture of a plumbing supply line is covered, subject to the deductible. The failed section of supply line itself is not covered.

Q2.known_answer: Yes. E-19 excludes continuous or repeated seepage or leakage over 14 days or more from a plumbing, heating, air conditioning or sprinkler system. The 14-day clock runs from first escape of water, not from discovery.

Q3.known_answer: Yes. E-21 excludes fungi, wet or dry rot and bacteria including remediation, and applies even where the fungi results from an otherwise covered water loss. HO-0521 then grants back a limited $10,000 aggregate.

Q5.known_answer: Abrupt in onset AND unexpected/unintended by the insured. Both elements required. The escape of water is the event, not its discovery.

Q6.known_answer: Under the homeowners form, only if it lasted under 14 days — E-19 excludes seepage of 14 days or more. Note DP-0110 answers the same question differently for dwelling fire, which is why this question needs the policy_line filter.

Q7.clause: SECTION I — SPECIAL LIMITS OF LIABILITY / A
Q7.known_answer: $10,000 in the aggregate per policy period, including testing, monitoring, containment, removal and verification. Does not reset on mid-term renewal.

Q8.clause: SECTION I — DUTIES AFTER LOSS / C
Q8.known_answer: 60 days after OUR REQUEST — not 60 days after the loss, and not from the date notice was given. We may extend the period in writing.
